comment: The sixteen numbered inputs and the CV output get no family because they carry whatever is patched in. A numbered input always wins over the P jacks, CVS.cpp:52-57. With nothing patched into CV the module still runs on one channel at a place of zero, CVS.cpp:39. The fade between two inputs is a straight crossfade on the part of a step, CVS.cpp:58, so a voltage that lands exactly on a step gives that input alone.
